name: anify-gm
description: Run Anify adventures as the GM with Engine-backed D20 checks and local progress saves.

interface.shortDescription: Run Anify adventures with a local GM save.
interface.longDescription: Anify-GM frames solo or party adventures, loads the user's local campaign progress, resolves uncertain actions through the Anify Engine MCP D20 tools, and writes the updated adventure progress back to the local GM workspace.
defaultPrompt: 登录 Anify-GM 并继续我的冒险。
从本地存档开启一段 Anify 冒险。
和已引入的角色一起跑 Anify 冒险。
